Self-Healing Retrieval.title: 25 runtime packets returned fewer than 8 sourceRefs
Self-Healing Retrieval.why: Route runtime telemetry shows 25/26 packets with Qdrant hits but low sourceRef density. This weakens replay, traversal, and recommendation lineage.
Self-Healing Retrieval.action: Review CHR97 cartridge hit expansion and sourceRef density thresholds; replay a representative packet before changing scoring.
Self-Healing Retrieval.next_command: npm run atlas:runtime-packets:report && cd sveltekit-frontend && npx tsx ../scripts/tests/smoke-runtime-packet-replay.mjs

Self-Healing Retrieval.title: 3 empty-sourceRef packets and 44 historical unknown sourceRef hits
Self-Healing Retrieval.why: Runtime packets must be replayable from sourceRef lineage. Empty or placeholder sourceRefs break Parent Atlas joins and Redis packet decoding.
Self-Healing Retrieval.action: Keep the sourceRef normalizer in the hot path and monitor new route_runtime_packets rows for empty/unknown refs.

Self-Healing Retrieval.title: 3 runtime packets have no featureIds
Self-Healing Retrieval.why: Feature IDs are the join spine for recommendations, Neo4j ParentAtlasFeature nodes, and packet replay ranking.
Self-Healing Retrieval.action: Backfill feature IDs from parent_atlas_documents for telemetry sourceRefs before writing the runtime packet.

Self-Healing Retrieval.title: 25 runtime packets are missing SOM/cluster telemetry
Self-Healing Retrieval.why: Active production files have Qdrant and SOM coverage, but the runtime telemetry row is not always carrying the selected SOM cluster.
Self-Healing Retrieval.action: Resolve SOM cluster from sourceRefs or qdrant IDs before writing route_runtime_packets.

Self-Healing Retrieval.title: 4/25 recent runtime packets missing Redis LOD0 replay keys
Self-Healing Retrieval.why: A route_runtime_packets row without ace:telemetry:{id}:lod0 cannot be replayed from packet_id alone.
Self-Healing Retrieval.action: Replay smoke should continue checking Redis LOD0 coverage; investigate fire-and-forget compression misses if this remains nonzero.
